authorization: User asks to continue from the current infrastructure and findings on 2026-09-07.
adaptive_origin: v1 found more large-rally targets but lost money; this is an explicitly adaptive new objective, not untouched validation of v1.
scope_this_round: Resolve the 13 already-identified missing outcomes using documented token quantities and public prices exactly at the existing 7-day horizon.
Keep unresolved exits censored rather than labeling them -100% or zero.
Recalculate fixed v1 selections only as accounting sensitivity; never rewrite original evidence.
Implement and unit-test a net-payoff and abstention scorer; produce a current dry-run snapshot without measuring new historical performance.
identity_policy: Use official migration ratios and successor closing prices on the exact original exit day. For unchanged assets with another quote pair, use that pair's close multiplied by the quote/USDT close; no stablecoin peg assumption. This is a valuation proxy, not synchronized executable fills. No price after the outcome horizon, no last-price forward-fill, no automatic zero recovery. Raw requests and sources retain actual retrieval known_at.
frozen_inputs: Same 240-symbol v1 sample, 8 features, Monday decision, full 24h feature delay, 7-day holding and fixed 2021-2023 training geometry. Keep the original universe to isolate the objective; fix the separate future universe helper so JUP/SYRUP are not mistaken for leveraged products. No resampling after outcomes.

model.geometry: Training-only median/IQR, zero IQR=>1, clip [-5,5], Euclidean nearest neighbors; same as v1.
model.target: Log wealth factor after assumed transaction costs, including the magnitude of gains and losses. For a direct USDT exit, factor=(1+r)*(1-c)/(1+c). A cross-quote exit uses two sell legs: factor=(1+r)*(1-c)^2/(1+c).
model.cost_status: ASSUMED_UNCALIBRATED, inherited v1 scenario; not a change to v3/costs.py.
model.dependence: Average log payoffs within each distinct training week among neighbors, then weight those weeks equally. Require >=20 distinct weeks. For a conservative heuristic uncertainty penalty, effective_n=floor(number_of_weeks/4), score=mean_weekly_group_log_payoff - 1.96*sample_sd/sqrt(effective_n). This is not a calibrated confidence interval or a probability.
model.censoring: All training observations remain in the neighbor geometry. If any of the 200 neighbor outcomes is censored, abstain for that candidate; never delete the losing/censored case or replace its return with zero.
model.selection: Rank positive scores only. Up to five candidates, each 20% of starting research portfolio; unused slots remain zero-yield USDT cash, including 100% cash if none pass. No forcing five purchases. Ties by symbol.
model.snapshot: A diagnostic snapshot from the already-consumed 2026-09-07 inputs, explicitly not a prospective recommendation or executable signal.
